correctness.pending_judge: unknown; never silently excluded from the full denominator
correctness.malformed_deterministic_answer: recover only unambiguous values; otherwise semantic unknown and explicit unscorable_format failure; no additional LLM calls
correctness.score_scale: DeepEval raw0–10 is normalized to0–1; compare normalized score>=0.8 inclusively; require matching recorded threshold and metric version
correctness.automatic_selection: Judge-only runs always include semantic_correctness even with legacy diagnostic metric lists; explicit --diagnostics-only opts out

outcomes.success: execution completed AND semantic_correct; format does not gate this value
outcomes.strict_success: format_success AND completion_type=natural_completion; forced finals, step limits and truncation never count
outcomes.format_ok: true/false/not applicable, independently of gold value correctness
outcomes.format_success: success AND format_ok where a format is specified

resources.source: frozen RunConfig, identical across frameworks in a comparison
resources.call_cap: shared proxy counts every admitted generation request, including forced finalization and failed upstream attempts; rejected attempts are recorded separately
resources.output_cap: proxy sets min(per-call cap, remaining total output cap); completion usage includes reasoning tokens
resources.total_output_cap_default: max_llm_calls * sampling.max_tokens; explicit limits.max_total_output_tokens may lower this
resources.retries: consume the same call budget; client_retries remains 0 in the supplied configs
resources.deadline: reject new generation requests after the task deadline and classify elapsed overruns as timeout; no hard preemption of an in-progress tool or model request
resources.comparison: do not pool different call/output caps, timeouts or accounting policies

cap_flags.output_cap_reached: union of per_call_output_cap_reached and total_output_cap_reached, including unknown length terminations
cap_flags.per_call_output_cap_reached: a call reached its per-call output ceiling, including finish_reason=length at that ceiling
cap_flags.total_output_cap_reached: run-total completion output is exhausted, or length occurs at a proxy-shrunk remaining-total allowance

termination.natural_stop: stop response, including at the last permitted call, may complete
termination.forced_final_answer: retain completed status for valid stop within shared budgets and keep content scores; completion_type=forced_final and strict_success=false
termination.completion_type: natural_completion | forced_final | step_limit | truncated | timeout | error | unknown_completion

reporting.denominator: all planned tasks and repeats; include failures, truncations and pending judgments
reporting.coverage: report pending judgments, unscorable content and semantic/format coverage
reporting.cost: all run tokens and elapsed time divided by confirmed successes; label provisional while judgments are pending
reporting.judge_provenance: judge_id, evaluation_version and answer_fingerprint required; select one judge explicitly if several are present
reporting.execution_plan: plan.jsonl is written before execution; missing/duplicate/unexpected runs prevent a complete benchmark result
reporting.task_version: new runs fingerprint their task definition; changed definitions are not silently rescored
reporting.accounting_revision: The derived export reconstructs flags from raw calls; original telemetry is preserved. Outcome revision is independent of frozen task-definition fingerprints.
